blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven current V96 renders and Astra review: piping at both front-lap hem ends still kinks outward into short protruding tips; the hem-only edge filter has not materially improved those terminations.

Neutral, side, rear and three-quarter views retain dense horizontal ridging along the overskirt sides. Crouch and sit retain angular panel overlaps and bunching around and behind the raised thighs; the skirt silhouette is still visibly stiff and broken rather than a continuous drape.
The garment remains a prototype. Avatar fit, Shape Key response, complete UVs, Unity/VRChat runtime, and release package readiness are unverified; no release gate is satisfied by this visual review.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
